name: util_fixAllRunNumbers
description: MAINTENANCE SP — run manually by the developer only, never called by the API or any automated process. Recalculates HC.Event.EventNumber for every qualifying event across all kennels in a single pass using the same island-group window function logic as nonApi_updateRunNumbers, but partitioned by KennelId so each kennel's numbering sequence is independent. Intended as a sweep to fix EventNumber = 0 or stale-number inconsistencies left by trigger timing gaps or bulk data operations. Returns two rowsets reporting what was changed.

rowsets.name: PerKennelSummary
rowsets.description: On success: one row per kennel where at least one EventNumber was corrected, ordered by KennelName; empty when no corrections were needed. On failure the CATCH returns the ErrorEnvelope rowset at index 0 instead (see rowset 'ErrorEnvelope').

columns.name: KennelName
columns.description: HC.Kennel.KennelName — display name of the kennel.

columns.name: EventsFixed
columns.description: COUNT(*) of events whose EventNumber was changed in this kennel.

columns.name: OldMin
columns.description: Minimum old EventNumber value among changed rows in this kennel.

columns.name: OldMax
columns.description: Maximum old EventNumber value among changed rows in this kennel.

columns.name: NewMin
columns.description: Minimum new EventNumber value among changed rows in this kennel.

columns.name: NewMax
columns.description: Maximum new EventNumber value among changed rows in this kennel.

rowsets.name: TotalSummary
rowsets.description: Always exactly 1 row on success — the total count of events corrected across all kennels. Absent on failure.

columns.name: TotalEventsFixed
columns.description: Total COUNT(*) of events whose EventNumber was changed across all kennels.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Only when the CATCH runs, and then the only rowset: { Success 0, ErrorMessage }. Not the StandardErrorResult shape, and NOT logged to HC.ErrorLog.

sideEffects: UPDATEs HC.Event.EventNumber and HC.Event.updatedAt (CONVERT(datetimeoffset(7), SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(), 0)) for every qualifying event (counted, visible, not removed, not deleted, EventStartLocal not NULL) across all kennels whose computed number differs; the Event updatedAt trigger fires and those runs re-sync.
All updates are wrapped in a single transaction — either all kennels are updated or none (on error, transaction is rolled back).
On CATCH: transaction is rolled back; returns { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } instead of the normal rowsets.
Creates and drops #Updated (OUTPUT clause captures old and new numbers for the report).

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 115–118 roll back and SELECT { 0, ERROR_MESSAGE() } without an INSERT HC.ErrorLog. For a hand-run sweep the operator sees the message in SSMS, so nothing is lost today, but CLAUDE.md requires every CATCH to log; if this proc is ever scheduled, a failure would leave no server-side record.

codeSmells.issue: Updating updatedAt on all affected Event rows triggers trgRecalculateRunCounts for each row
codeSmells.detail: The UPDATE writes updatedAt, which fires the trgRecalculateRunCounts trigger on every modified event row. The trigger checks IF UPDATE(IsCountedRun) OR UPDATE(AbsoluteEventNumber) — neither is changed here, so the run-number recursion branch does not fire. However, trigger overhead (even for no-op checks) multiplies by the number of corrected rows. For a full sweep affecting many events, this adds measurable overhead.

codeSmells.issue: No guard against running in production during peak hours
codeSmells.detail: This is a developer-only maintenance SP that acquires row-level locks on HC.Event during the UPDATE. Running it during peak usage could cause lock contention with portal and app SPs that read/write HC.Event concurrently. Should be run only during low-traffic periods.
